title: AI Dubbing in ElevenLabs: Translate a Video and Keep the Voice
desc:
ElevenLabs dubbing translates audio and video across 90+ languages while preserving each speaker's emotion, timing and tone, and keeping the background audio. This episode walks through Automatic Dubbing step by step, the Speaker similarity (cloning strength) setting, Dubbing v2 versus the legacy Dubbing Studio, how dubbing is charged, output quality, and the limits to know first.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
